Run **your own copy** of Bryce 2, Bryce 3D or Bryce 4 (Windows editions) as a Mac app on Apple Silicon. Nothing from Bryce is included: you need your CD (or an image of it) and your serial number.

**Install**

1. Download **Bryce.dmg** below, open it and drag **Bryce** to **Applications**.
2. Open Bryce. The first time, macOS may say it can't verify the app: click **Done**, open **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, and click **Open Anyway** next to "Bryce".
3. Choose your Bryce CD image. The app recognises the version, sets it up in a few seconds, and Bryce asks for your name and serial number once (paste the serial with Ctrl+V).

Extra content discs (Bryce 2 accessories, Bryce 4 content CD) can be added in **Settings › Content CDs**.

**Upgrading from "Bryce 3D" 2.0.x:** install this app and delete the old "Bryce 3D" app. Your installed Bryce 3D, its registration and Documents › Bryce 3D are kept.

Needs an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 14 or later and about 4 GB of free space. Rosetta is not used. Full instructions: see the README.

**Licenses:** the app contains a small Linux system (Ubuntu packages, Hangover Wine, FEX). `SOURCES.md` lists every package with links to its source code and includes the written offer for GPL/LGPL source; `packages.tsv` is the same list in machine-readable form.
